messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Our redline attached. Headline changes: ex-gratia up to £95k, fees contribution to £2,500, covenants reduced to 9 months, and we've added an outplacement clause (we've put £5k). Subject to those, my client is minded to settle. The whistleblowing point isn't going away if we don't.

Oliver
